# LLaMA-3.1-8B SFT seed=43 train + eval pipeline

    --per_device_batch_size 1 \
    --gradient_accumulation_steps 16 \
    --num_epochs 3 \
    --learning_rate 2e-4 \
    --warmup_ratio 0.05 \
